description: Eight separate polyphonic paths, each with an attenuverter and a text box to write down what it carries

params.text: Scales the signal on its row between -1 and +1, so it can be attenuated, silenced or turned upside down

inputs.text: The signal for that row, which is scaled by that row's attenuverter and sent to that row's output with all its polyphonic channels

outputs.text: Carries that row's input after its attenuverter, with the same number of polyphonic channels; with nothing patched into the row it has no channels at all

notes: every attenuverter comes up at zero, so a fresh module passes nothing until one is turned up
the text box on each row takes up to 18 characters and is saved with the patch; it is a display rather than a control, so clicking it gives no note of its own
